description: This file is a shell script which contains a complex suite of tests for Perforce (p4) interaction, Git-P4 integration, and various file handling scenarios including newline conversions, encoding differences, keyword substitution, symbolic links, and special file types. It uses external tools and scripts, sets up test environments, and verifies correct behavior of version control operations.

methods.name: build_smush
methods.description: Constructs Python scripts for keyword unexpansion in files with various keyword tags like Id, Header, Author, etc.
